decided.singular: Narrow spikes clearly above the 0-5 band: the highest is about 8.7 near day 316. Others reach about 7.5-8 at days 1-2, 106 and 152-155, and about 6.6-7 at days 164, 258, 272-274 and 337.
decided.recurrence: The trace is dense and noisy. Spike spacings are irregular (gaps such as 46, 12, 94, 14, 42 days), and no evenly spaced 20-35 day pattern stands out in a single line plot.
decided.quarter: Q4 has the tallest spike (about 8.7 at day 316), several more spikes (272-274, 337, 343) and a sustained baseline of about 3-4 over days 325-360. Q2 is the runner-up, with peaks at 106 and 152-155.

answer.guess: Geomagnetic Kp index (8 three-hour values per day, 0-9 scale) over one year.
